India's Wholesale Inflation Rises to 11.39% in September

India's wholesale inflation surged to 11.39% in September, driven by rising prices of oil and food products. This marks an acceleration in wholesale price increases. In the United States, inflation reached 3.7%, with petrol prices increasing by 34% over the year.
